name: piano
title: Piano
author: AlgorizeTech
description: An interactive Playable Piano component featuring Web Audio API synthesizers, physical keyboard keybindings (A-S-D-F-G-H-J-K-L-; and W-E-T-Y-U-O-P), master volume slider, and toggleable key indicators.
docs: Named export: Piano. Supports `defaultVolume` (0 to 1), `defaultShowKeys` (boolean), and `className`. Synthesizes real acoustic piano notes using native Web Audio API.
